I will think about my favorite recipe for chocolate chip cookies. First, I preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). In a bowl, I whisk together 2¼ cups of all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon of baking soda, and ½ teaspoon of salt. Then, I cream together 1 cup of softened butter, ¾ cup of packed brown sugar, and ¾ cup of granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Next, I add 2 large eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition, and stir in 2 teaspoons of vanilla extract. After that, I gradually mix in the dry ingredients until just combined. Finally, I fold in 2 cups of semisweet chocolate chips. I drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto a baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown but the centers are still soft. Let them cool on a wire rack before enjoying the warm, chewy cookies.
